metadata.name: Inventory of GIS zip and Excel files
metadata.description: A table of 10 records where each row contains either a GIS zip file name or an Excel file name. The GIS column holds 9 distinct zip files (e.g., Big_Skidder.zip) and the XLSX column holds a single Excel file (TopographicHigh_RawData.xlsx). Exactly one of the two columns is populated per row. (Based on get_item_count=10 and get_field_statistics).
